info.title: API.SH: Mastodon
info.description: The Mastodon API from API.SH: public Mastodon data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Mastodon server rules, about, activity and moderation
get.description:
A server's rules, its long about text, weekly activity (posts, logins and sign-ups for the last 12 weeks), the servers it limits or suspends with the reason it gives, and, with peers=true, the servers it knows (peers) when it publishes them. Fields a server keeps private come back null.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mastodon-instance-rules

parameters.description: Mastodon-compatible server host name (default mastodon.social).

parameters.name: peers_limit
parameters.description: With peers=true: most peers to list (default 1000; peers_count is always the full count).

parameters.name: peers
parameters.description: true also lists the servers this one knows (can be a very long list; off by default).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
An account's posts, newest first: text and HTML, content warning, language, visibility, replies, boosts, likes, quotes, media with alt text and size, link card, poll, mentions, hashtags, the boosted post, the quoted post (`quote`: state and the quoted post) and who may quote it (`quote_policy`). Filter out replies or boosts, only media, only pinned posts or posts with one hashtag. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mastodon-statuses

parameters.description: Only posts right after this post id, oldest first page (page forward by passing the newest returned id back as `min_id`).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Posts per page, 1-40 (default 20).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page; null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A server's public timeline, newest first: its own members' posts (local), every public post the server knows (federated), or only posts from other servers (remote), optionally only posts with media. Each post as in the other timelines: text and HTML, author, counts, media, link card, poll, mentions and hashtags. Some servers keep their timelines for signed-in members; those answer 403. Pass `next_cursor` back as `cursor`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mastodon-timeline

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: Mastodon-compatible server host name.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: local (default): this server's own posts; federated: all public posts the server knows; remote: posts from other servers only.

parameters.name: only_media
parameters.description: true for posts with media attachments only.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Posts per page (1-40, default 20).

parameters.name: since_id
parameters.description: Only posts newer than this post id.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` from the previous page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
What is trending on a server: hashtags (uses and accounts per day for the last week), posts, or news links (title, description, publisher, image and shares per day). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/mastodon-trends

parameters.name: instance
parameters.description: Mastodon-compatible server host name (default mastodon.social).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: tags (default), statuses or links.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items per page (tags up to 20, posts and links up to 40).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
